content.title: Day-to-Night Product Proof | Persistent Result and Package Close
content.summary: A fictional cushion proves one conductor's finish from morning colonnade to night gallery. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One adult identity and one applied result anchor both time states. + A continuous movement or threshold links daylight and night. + The night close-up verifies persistence without applying another product. + One complete original package appears after the human proof. + The final frame reconnects person, persistent result, package and one exact claim.
quick_start.recommended_input: Lock one adult original violin conductor with a short black bob, silver necklace and navy dress on a pale morning colonnade. Carry the same walk into an amber night gallery through one doorway without changing identity or makeup. Show one complete fictional cushion case labeled "LONG ARC", then reconnect it beside the same conductor under the exact line "MORNING TO LAST NOTE".
required_anchors: One adult identity and one applied result anchor both time states.
A continuous movement or threshold links daylight and night.
One complete original package appears after the human proof.
The final frame reconnects person, persistent result, package and one exact claim.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A fictional cushion proves one conductor's finish from morning colonnade to night gallery. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.

invariants.rule: One adult identity and one applied result anchor both time states.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One adult identity and one applied result anchor both time states."

invariants.rule: A continuous movement or threshold links daylight and night.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "A continuous movement or threshold links daylight and night."

invariants.rule: The night close-up verifies persistence without applying another product.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "The night close-up verifies persistence without applying another product."

invariants.rule: One complete original package appears after the human proof.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "One complete original package appears after the human proof."

invariants.rule: The final frame reconnects person, persistent result, package and one exact claim.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final frame reconnects person, persistent result, package and one exact claim."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
